title: Componentwise isomorphism of the restricted sections lift
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], K a bounded-below complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and T an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. For any integers q,n, the degree-n component of the canonical factorization of the restricted sections inclusion [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-total-construction] through T.L.step q, supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-sections-factors], is an isomorphism.

source.place: Proof remark (3) and finite-diagonal comparison; Tag 0133, augmented-total quasi-isomorphism

proof.text: The factorization component is monic because its composite with the monic step arrow is the restricted sections inclusion, which is degreewise monic.
The factorization component is epic by the finite diagonal comparison onto the second-filtration step.
In the abelian category of additive groups, a morphism that is both monic and epic is an isomorphism.

theorem etaleRestrictedSectionsLift_component_isIso
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (T : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K) (q n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (((T.L.step q).factorThru (etaleRestrictedSectionsInclusion X K T q)
      (etaleRestrictedSections_factors X K T q)).f n)
